name: Coimbatore
description: Coimbatore is a mid-sized industrial and textile hub tucked against the Western Ghats, offering the lowest cost of living of India's major retirement-friendly cities. The Palghat Gap funnels a near-constant breeze through the city, tempering the tropical heat that defines most of South India and making it noticeably more comfortable than Chennai or Delhi. It's a quieter, more understated choice than Bengaluru or Goa — the expat community is small and the pace is unmistakably local — but the Nilgiri hill towns like Ooty are an easy day trip away. For FIRE seekers prioritizing value and calm over cosmopolitan buzz, Coimbatore delivers exceptional stretch for the dollar.

quickFacts.visa: India has no retirement, pension, or passive-income visa. US citizens use the e-Tourist visa — 30-day (double-entry) or 1-year/5-year (multiple-entry; the 5-year fee rose from $80 to $200 in 2026) — and may stay up to 180 days per visit, with total time capped at 180 days per calendar year; long-term residents get by cycling visas in and out. The only path to living in India indefinitely is the OCI card, open to people of Indian origin or those married 2+ years to an Indian citizen or OCI holder.
quickFacts.internetSpeed: 50–100 Mbps typical; solid fiber for a Tier-2 city, up to 1 Gbps
quickFacts.safetyRating: A calm, low-crime industrial city widely regarded as safe and easygoing; ordinary precautions suffice
quickFacts.climate: Tropical savanna moderated by the Palghat Gap — warm, comparatively dry, with a near-constant cooling breeze

1M.lifestyle: A comfortable 2-bedroom apartment in R.S. Puram or Race Course, getting around by auto-rickshaw and ride-hailing in a compact, easy-to-navigate city. Eating at South Indian thali counters and casual restaurants most days, with occasional nicer meals out. Private health insurance covers Kovai Medical Center and PSG Hospitals. Coimbatore's near-constant breeze and low costs make this the most affordable comfortable lifestyle among India's major retirement-friendly cities, though the expat community here is smaller than in Bengaluru or Goa.

10M.lifestyle: A palatial independent villa or estate in Race Course, Coimbatore's most exclusive address, with full household staff including a housekeeper, a cook several times a week, drivers, and a gardener. Multiple vehicles, first-class international flights, and top-tier global health coverage. Dining at any restaurant in the city without a thought. Coimbatore's costs are so low relative to this budget that the vast majority goes unspent each month, leaving room for the Western Ghats and beyond as a permanent backyard.
